say smoke-start
whitelist off
gamerule spawn_radius 0
gamerule spawn_mobs false
forceload add -16 -32 63 31
fill -6 199 -20 60 199 18 minecraft:stone
fill -6 200 -20 60 206 18 minecraft:air
say == line 1: two entrances 36 blocks apart, 16 rpm
setblock 0 200 0 create_hypertube:hypertube_entrance[facing=east,locked=false]
setblock 36 200 0 create_hypertube:hypertube_entrance[facing=west,locked=false]
setblock 0 200 1 create:cogwheel[axis=x]
setblock -1 200 1 create:creative_motor[facing=east]{ScrollValue:16}
setblock 36 200 1 create:cogwheel[axis=x]
setblock 37 200 1 create:creative_motor[facing=west]{ScrollValue:16}
say == line 2: entrance, accelerator, junction, two exits, 64 rpm
setblock 0 200 10 create_hypertube:hypertube_entrance[facing=east,locked=false]
setblock 0 200 11 create:cogwheel[axis=x]
setblock -1 200 11 create:creative_motor[facing=east]{ScrollValue:64}
setblock 8 200 10 create_hypertube:hypertube_accelerator[facing=east]
setblock 8 200 11 create:cogwheel[axis=x]
setblock 7 200 11 create:creative_motor[facing=east]{ScrollValue:64}
setblock 16 200 10 create_hypertube:hypertube_junction[facing=north]
setblock 24 200 10 create_hypertube:hypertube_entrance[facing=west,locked=false]
setblock 24 200 11 create:cogwheel[axis=x]
setblock 25 200 11 create:creative_motor[facing=west]{ScrollValue:64}
setblock 16 200 4 create_hypertube:hypertube_entrance[facing=south,locked=false]
setblock 17 200 4 create:cogwheel[axis=z]
setblock 17 200 5 create:creative_motor[facing=north]{ScrollValue:64}
setblock 30 200 14 create_hypertube:hypertube
tick sprint 100
say CHECK blocks placed
data get block 0 200 0
data get block 36 200 0
data get block 8 200 10
data get block 16 200 10
data get block 30 200 14
